name: echo-trail

name: extended-keyframe

name: facet-morph

name: fade-through

name: filmed-screen

name: focus-blur-resolve
title: Focus Blur Resolve

name: focus-rack

name: gesture-tap

name: gloss-sweep

name: grade-split-reveal

name: grain-field

name: hw-arrow

name: hw-box-label
title: Hand-Drawn Box Label

name: hw-callout-circle
title: Scribble Callout Circle
about: Wobbled ellipse draws around a target with optional scribble fill and curved connector; the handwritten label pops in WITH momentum and the drawn shapes absorb the arrival with a volume-preserving contact squash; outline and connector take the family stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray); boils

name: hw-underline
title: Squiggle Marks
about: Hand-drawn squiggle underline, double-pass strikethrough, and bracket marks that draw on

name: icon-morph-beat

name: icon-swap

name: ink-bleed-reveal

name: input-feedback

title: Hairline Arc Gauge
about: Thin circular gauge that draws on while its percentage counts up; one helper call drives both

name: modal-morph
title: Modal Morph
about: A small card expands into a full panel, shared-element style: both layouts measured once at mount, the container morphs by transform only (never width/height tweens) while keyed children counter-scale and re-flow onto their own measured targets as pure functions of time.

name: morph-swap
title: Morph Swap
about: Two slotted siblings stacked at one shared center: A holds, then condenses or reshapes into B on a shared 50% 50% transform origin. Condense shrink-fades A exactly as B scales up; reshape morphs the silhouette on scaleX/scaleY, never width or height tweens. Token card defaults render when a slot is left empty.

name: morph-text
title: Morph Text
about: Gooey text morph — cycles through an editable word list using SVG threshold + GSAP-driven blur for a fluid, satisfying transition effect

name: motion-blur
title: Motion Blur
about: After Effects-style motion blur — integrates each element over a shutter window (shutter angle, phase, samples per frame) by sampling the GSAP timeline at sub-frame times and averaging equal-weight additive copies of the element along its real trajectory, so translation, scale, rotation, 3D rotation and skew all drive the smear

name: multi-device-splay
title: Multi Device Splay
about: Phone, tablet, and desktop product mockups fan from a centered stack into a proud splayed arrangement with a subtle idle float.

name: multiplayer-cursors
title: Multiplayer Cursors
about: Labeled collaborator cursors with token-derived colors and soft glows drift from spread positions into a shared center zone, proving live multiplayer presence.

name: native-notification-pop
title: Native Notification Pop
about: One system-faithful notification banner (iOS or macOS) drops in over any scene on an accurate interruptible spring: fast arrival, soft overshoot, settled mass, backdrop blur, app dot, title, one body line. Holds; tucks away only via exit.

name: notes-typing
title: Notes Typing
about: The notes-app confession as a mountable scene: a bold title, then body lines typed character by character on the measured human keystroke rhythm, the caret riding every landed character and jumping down at each paragraph. For a bare prompt line use typed-prompt; for an even mechanical reveal use typewriter

name: notification-pileup
title: Notification Pileup
about: Mobile notification cards arrive faster and faster, each new alert pushing the existing stack downward into a dense, anxious tower.

name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
about: 1 to 5 token notification cards slide-settle into a vertical stack on cues, newest on top; one card grows slightly and brightens as the focus while the rest dim by position.

name: number-pop-in
title: Number Pop In
about: A transitions.dev-inspired digit pop-in with blur, lift, and staggered value reveal

name: number-wheel
title: Number Wheel
about: A rolling digit counter primitive for metrics, prices, counts, and scoreboards

name: offset-path-traveler
title: Offset Path Traveler
about: A slotted traveler follows an authored path with tangent rotation, curved entry, and curved exit.

name: onboarding-stepper-flow
title: Onboarding Stepper Flow
about: A composed onboarding flow with milestone rail, active step card, and next-action button

name: ordered-dither-pass
title: Ordered Dither Pass
about: Bayer-matrix ordered dithering quantizes a slotted scene (rasterized once at mount): the image emerges from pure 2-tone noise to clean, or dissolves the reverse. Stateless per frame, never error diffusion.

name: outline-draw
title: Outline Draw
about: A rounded outline that proves a callout by drawing clockwise as a hollow conic-gradient border with a clean closure.

name: oversized-cursor
title: Oversized Cursor
about: The look-here pointer for a video: the macOS arrow at 3.5x its normal size lands its tip on one control, clicks it on, settles just below it so the result stays in view, then exits off-screen

name: overwhelm-surround
title: Overwhelm Surround
about: Tasks, tabs, pings, and notification bubbles accelerate inward around a calm central subject, turning overload into visible spatial pressure.

name: page-slide
title: Page Slide
about: A transitions.dev-inspired page slide primitive with outgoing and incoming panels

name: panel-reveal
title: Panel Reveal
about: A panel reveal primitive with height expansion and content fade

name: pan-stations
title: Pan Stations
about: A lateral camera move across a continuous row of labeled feature stations, with a steady dwell at each stop before the next pan.

name: paper-collage-reveal
title: Paper Collage Reveal
about: A scrapbook patchwork of torn paper scraps, each with its own texture and tilt, flutters away in a staggered scatter to reveal the content underneath.

name: parallax-device-dive
title: Parallax Device Dive
about: A canonical phone rises into view before the camera pushes through its screen and layered app UI expands to fill the frame.

name: parallax-unzoom
title: Parallax Unzoom
about: Reveal transition — focus card scales down from full frame as siblings parallax in to form a grid (reverse of parallax-zoom)

name: parallax-zoom
title: Parallax Zoom
about: Center card scales up to fill the frame while siblings parallax outward — inspired by the eBay Playbook hero transition

name: particle-image-reveal
title: Particle Image Reveal
about: A seeded deterministic particle field converges and settles while a slotted image reveals beneath it, the trail thinning until the image holds clean.

name: particle-text-dissolve
title: Particle Text Dissolve
about: Text assembles from a seeded particle cloud (or dissolves into it): per-particle targets sampled once from the rendered text bitmap at mount, table-driven particles, zero per-particle tweens, one onUpdate painter.

name: pendulum-swing
title: Pendulum Swing
about: Content hangs from a fixed pivot and swings into rest with gravity-damped oscillation, like a hanging sign settling on its hook.

name: perspective-marquee
title: Perspective Marquee
about: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

name: per-word-crossfade
title: Per-Word Crossfade
about: Words gently fade into place with a short vertical drift for calm keynote rhythm.

name: per-word-rise
title: Per Word Rise
about: Words or characters rise into place in a controlled blur-to-sharp cascade, settle softly on landing, and hold still until the cut (optional fade or up exit).

name: physical-exit
title: Physical Exit
about: A card exits with physical momentum in toss, drop, or slide mode, carrying acceleration and rotation through the final offscreen pose without fading.

name: press-ripple
title: Press Ripple
about: A cursor decel-arrives from off-stage, lands slightly off-center on a caller-positioned target, compresses with it in lockstep, releases with two small click rings while the label swaps to a check, then exits off-stage while the confirmed state holds.

name: pull-back-reveal
title: Pull Back Reveal
about: A tight stat detail holds, then one decelerating camera pull-back reveals the headline and supporting cards that recontextualize it.

name: pull-to-refresh
title: Pull to Refresh
about: A mobile list pulls through nonlinear rubber-band resistance, arms at a threshold, commits to a bounded loading indicator, then snaps exactly back to rest.

name: push-in
title: Push In
about: A centered headline gains focus through one slow, continuous camera push and a gentle fade out.

name: radial-surround
title: Radial Surround
about: Labeled hairline chips assemble around a centered subject on an elliptical ring, then optionally converge inward with a subtle edge dim. The center never moves: surrounded, not zoomed.

name: rgb-glitch-text
title: RGB Glitch Text
about: RGB-offset text copies jitter briefly for a controlled glitch window.

name: rubber-band-bumper
title: Rubber Band Bumper
about: An outgoing panel pulls against increasing resistance, holds at tension, then snaps past an edge with overshoot as the incoming panel settles behind it.

name: scan-band
title: Scan Band
about: A diagonal distortion band sweeps once across a clean wordmark, revealing clipped red and cyan offsets only inside the moving band.

name: scramble-reveal
title: Scramble Reveal
about: A deterministic hacker-style text reveal that cycles fixed glyph rows and locks the target string from left to right.

name: screen-flow-carousel
title: Screen Flow Carousel
about: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.

name: scroll-camera-story
title: Scroll Camera Story
about: A compressed forced-scroll cinematic pass: a tall scene of slotted sections travels past the camera top to bottom, depth layers parallax at different rates, each section rises as the camera reaches it, and the pass decelerates into a held final section.

name: scroll-feed
title: Scroll Feed
about: A loop-friendly column of varied skeleton post cards scrolls upward with subtle motion trails and an agitated pace.

name: segmentation-flood
title: Segmentation Flood
about: Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.

name: separator
title: Separator
about: A one-pixel structural separator with horizontal and vertical variants plus a seek-safe progress reveal

name: settings-toggle-flow
title: Settings Toggle Flow
about: A composed settings flow with preference rows, toggle switches, and active-state feedback

name: shared-axis-y
title: Shared Axis Y
about: Per-word vertical shared-axis transition for sharp editorial swaps.

name: shared-axis-z
title: Shared Axis Z
about: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.

name: sheet-spring-up
title: Sheet Spring-Up
about: A bottom sheet rushes up from below the frame on a real spring sampled frame by frame from reference footage, overshooting its resting place and settling back without an approximated ease

name: shimmer-sweep
title: Shimmer Sweep
about: Animated light sweep across text or elements using a CSS gradient mask — ideal for AI accents and premium reveals

name: shutter-slam
title: Shutter Slam
about: One word thrown through six single-property beats under integrated shutter blur — two translate slams, a scale punch, then a full turn about each axis — on the measured easing of the After Effects export the shutter model was fitted to

name: signup-flow
title: Signup Flow
about: A composed signup flow with social action, email field, password field, and submit button

name: skeleton-reveal
title: Skeleton Reveal
about: A skeleton loader transition that pulses, then cross-fades into content

name: slit-scan-reveal
title: Slit Scan Reveal
about: The frame's rows sample an authored subject at offset times: a canvas painter draws row slices of one pure position function evaluated at t minus offset(row), smearing arrival through time until the offsets collapse to zero and the mark holds coherent.

name: slot-machine-roll
title: Slot Machine Roll
about: A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

name: social-proof-card
title: Social Proof Card
about: The app-store close as one mountable scene: wordmark, five stars, a proof line, three feature icons and a CTA capsule build in a quiet stagger and hold - measured from reference ad footage. For an animated star sweep use star-rating-fill; for a quote card use testimonial-proof-card; for a bare lockup use cta-lockup

name: soft-blob-touch
title: Soft Blob Touch
about: A granular soft blob idles with slow internal drift; a scripted touch dot decel-arrives, the blob deforms toward it with an attraction bulge, then recovers with a velocity-preserving spring. No hard edges anywhere.

name: soft-blur-in
title: Soft Blur In
about: A soft opacity, blur, and lift reveal for headlines, captions, and product UI callouts

name: split-tilt-cards
title: Split Tilt Cards
about: Two equal-weight cards arrive from opposite wings with mirrored rotateY book-open tilts under one shared perspective, pill badges spring-pop at each inner edge, and the pair holds with a barely-there phase-opposed idle float. Card bodies are content slots with token skeleton defaults.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
about: A card with a scripted cursor spotlight and lit border.

name: spring-pop
title: Spring Pop
about: A badge pops in from a visible near-rest scale, overshoots full size once, and settles cleanly.

name: spring-stack-shuffle
title: Spring Stack Shuffle
about: A stack of 3 to 5 slotted cards reshuffles on cues: the back card throws over the top and lands at the front with real mass, the rest compress and resettle; cues that land mid-flight redirect the moving cards with velocity preserved.

name: stagger-cascade
title: Stagger Cascade
about: A responsive grid of tile cards that fades and travels into place with an evenly spaced per-item GSAP stagger. The ordered cascade is the only visual mechanic.

name: staggered-fade-up
title: Staggered Fade Up
about: Words fade in and slide up one after another with configurable delay.

name: stagger-lattice
title: Stagger Lattice
about: A staggered grid reveal inspired by Anime.js v4 stagger utilities, implemented with GSAP for HyperFrames.

name: star-rating-fill
title: Star Rating Fill
about: A token-driven star row whose colored layer sweeps to a rating, preserves the fractional final star, and can count the value in sync.

name: state-chip-rail
title: State Chip Rail
about: A rail of mono status chips advances a seek-safe data-state snap machine on a cue schedule: active chip ink on surface, done chips dim, pending chips hollow, optional badges pop beside one state.

name: sticky-mock-swap
title: Sticky Mock Swap
about: A pinned product mock cross-fades through accent-tinted feature states while matching captions rise, hold, and exit beside it.

name: stitched-text-draw
title: Stitched Text Draw
about: Text drawn as thread stitches: a single-stroke display alphabet draws via attribute-driven dashoffset with stitch-tuned dash patterns, seeded angle jitter, needle-hole dots, a leading needle, and a thread-tail overshoot per letter.

name: stop-motion-cadence
title: Stop Motion Cadence
about: The stepped-time law as a demo primitive: one driver quantizes timeline time to floor(t * fps) / fps and feeds ALL motion; four token paper-cut shapes throw-and-land with squash on hits, 2-frame boil jitter seeded per step, and sparkle accents living exactly 2 to 3 frames.

name: store-badge-lockup
title: Store Badge Lockup
about: Settles a short headline above equal-size App Store and Google Play badges as a token-driven mobile end-card call to action.

name: streaming-text
title: Streaming Text
about: Words arrive the way an AI answer streams - in uneven bursts on a measured token rhythm, each word landing grey and inking to full colour - rather than the even tick of a typewriter

name: strikethrough-replace
title: Strikethrough Replace
about: Draw a strike line across old text, then reveal the replacement.

name: success-check
title: Success Check
about: A success check primitive with ring pop, path draw, and subtle rotate blur

name: svg-line-draw-loader
title: SVG Line Draw Loader
about: An Anime.js-style path drawing loader implemented as a seekable GSAP stroke timeline.

name: svg-mask-reveal
title: SVG Mask Reveal
about: A soft token-colored sweep reveals media only through an editable SVG wordmark mask.

name: svg-stroke-trace
title: SVG Stroke Trace
about: An authored SVG path draws from its measured length, holds with subtle drift, and optionally fills when the path is closed.

name: swipe-rail
title: Swipe Rail
about: A contact circle leads a horizontal card rail through a fast drag, momentum carry, and settled snap to the next card.

name: tabs-slide-indicator
title: Tabs Slide Indicator
about: A pill indicator transition that slides between active tabs

name: telemetry-hud
title: Telemetry HUD
about: Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.

name: terminal-simulator
title: Terminal Simulator
about: A terminal window types commands and streams log output.

name: testimonial-card
title: Testimonial Card
about: Reveals a customer quote at reading pace, then settles its avatar, author name, and handle beneath as a clean proof beat.

name: testimonial-proof-card
title: Testimonial Proof Card
about: A quote card whose testimonial reveals per-line through a soft mask, with an avatar disc (initials default, image slot), mono name and role, an optional company text mark, and one emphasis substring underlined in accent ink after the quote lands.

name: text-match-cut
title: Text Match Cut
about: One line of text becomes another mid-move: both ride a single 85 % easy-ease curve and hard-swap at the speed peak, as scale, tracking, or a same-direction slide.

name: text-shimmer
title: Text Shimmer
about: A static headline receives one clean specular gradient sweep through its glyphs, then returns to its ordinary text color.

name: text-stagger
title: Text Stagger
about: A transitions.dev-inspired text stagger primitive with enter, shimmer, and exit-ready words

name: text-state-swap
title: Text State Swap
about: A text state swap primitive with outgoing blur and incoming lift

name: texture-mask-text
title: Texture Mask Text
about: CSS luminance masks that cut holes through letterforms - 66 pre-built texture masks from ambientCG PBR color maps

name: three-orbiting-cards
title: Three Orbiting Cards
about: A Three.js-powered orbit scene driven by a paused GSAP timeline for deterministic renders.

name: ticker-takeover
title: Ticker Takeover
about: A mono ticker rolls through options, locks on a final word with an accent flash, and promotes it into a full-frame headline.

name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
about: A transitions.dev-inspired tilt card primitive with depth layers and hover-style parallax

name: titlecard-calm
title: Titlecard Calm
about: A restrained title card where a mono kicker and generous grotesque headline fade upward, drift almost imperceptibly, and exit cleanly.

name: titlecard-lockup
title: Titlecard Lockup
about: The calm breather titlecard: an optional mono kicker fades up, the wordmark settles dead-center with one restrained move, a hairline rule draws left to right, a mono label fades beneath, and the lockup holds truly still.

name: toggle-flip
title: Toggle Flip
about: An oversized UI toggle switch that flips with real physicality: thumb overshoot, track color crossfade, and a soft press-compress before release. The reference prop of the ui-props family.

name: top-down-letters
title: Top-Down Letters
about: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.

name: torn-paper-rip
title: Torn Paper Rip
about: A fibrous paper tear runs across the frame: the torn sheet shows its white paper core along the edge and lifts away on a soft shadow, leaving the next scene standing.

name: touch-indicator
title: Touch Indicator
about: A translucent contact-circle gesture actor for mobile UI scenes: it touches the glass on the frame the host target responds, then lifts. Tap or swipe, picked by variable.

name: tracing-beam
title: Tracing Beam
about: A glowing dash follows one SVG path through three UI elements, lifting and brightening each element in sequence.

name: tracking-in
title: Tracking In
about: A precise letter-spacing reveal for premium headings and interface labels

name: trust-strip
title: Trust Strip
about: A monochrome trust row of wide-tracked mono wordmarks that fade in with an opacity-only left-to-right stagger, then hold dead still.

name: typed-prompt
title: Typed Prompt
about: A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.

name: type-match-cut
title: Type Match Cut
about: A headline splits vertically around an incoming panel, which grows from the negative space and takes the frame as the words exit through opposite edges.

name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
about: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

name: typing-indicator
title: Typing Indicator
about: The three-dot chat bubble that says someone is writing: it pops in at the thread's edge exactly as messaging apps do, holds while the reply is coming, and vanishes when the message lands

name: ui-focus-zoom
title: UI Focus Zoom
about: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

name: variable-axis-type
title: Variable Axis Type
about: A locked one-line headline whose weight or width axis morphs into a decisive emphasis beat.

name: variable-font-flex
title: Variable Font Flex
about: A word lands while its variable-font weight and width axes flex from hairline-condensed to black-wide with per-character stagger; font-size eases inversely so the letterforms gain mass while the box holds.

name: vector-editor-rig
title: Vector Editor Rig
about: A dark design-tool app chrome with a live vector pen path, sequential anchor points, bezier handles, a selection frame, and theme-driven blue accents.

name: velocity-throw-snap
title: Velocity Throw Snap
about: A five-shot rail whips past on a fast decaying curve, then overshoots and snaps the selected hero shot exactly to center.

name: vignette
title: Vignette
about: Cinematic radial vignette overlay using a pure-CSS gradient — darkens the edges to pull focus toward the center

name: vox-annotate
title: Vox Annotate
about: The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.

name: whip-pan-cut
title: Whip Pan Cut
about: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

name: whiteboard-ink
title: Whiteboard Ink
about: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.

name: wordmark-tiles
title: Wordmark Tiles
about: A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.

name: x-follow-card
title: X Follow Card
about: A social follow card with avatar, handle, and follower motion.

name: yt-camera-move
title: Camera Punch-In
about: Dynamic zoom, slide, and 3D tilt-pan helpers for any wrapper (video, include, card) with cubic-easing defaults and an edge-defocus pulse overlay

name: yt-circle-pointer
title: Pointer Circle + Countdown
about: Draw-on annotation ellipse around a target plus a countdown chip that pulses each tick

name: yt-feather-highlight
title: Feathered Spotlight
about: Dims the frame except a feathered ellipse; the hole's position and size are CSS variables, so helpers glide the spotlight between targets

name: yt-screen-warp
title: On-Screen Display Effect
about: Grid, scanline, vignette, and sheen overlay plus a 3D-warp wrapper class that makes footage read as if playing on a physical display

name: zoom-through-transition
title: Zoom Through Transition
about: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.

name: decision-tree
title: Decision Tree
about: Animated flowchart with branching paths

name: kinetic-type
title: Kinetic Type
about: Bold kinetic typography promo

name: nyt-graph
title: NYT Graph
about: Animated data chart in print editorial style

name: path-traced-3d
title: Path-Traced 3D
about: Three.js scene with a fast raster preview and an opt-in path-traced export

name: play-mode
title: Play Mode
about: Playful elastic animations

name: product-promo
title: Product Promo
about: Multi-scene product showcase with SVG assets

name: swiss-grid
title: Swiss Grid
about: Structured grid layout

name: vignelli
title: Vignelli
about: Bold typography with red accents

name: warm-grain
title: Warm Grain
about: Cream aesthetic with grain texture
